Most people think deleting a post or clearing their history makes them invisible. It doesn't. From hidden metadata in your photos to your Wi-Fi signal's physical location, the "invisible" web remembers everything.

​I’ve compiled 5 of the most powerful tools used by pros for information gathering:
1️⃣ Hudson Rock – See if you're already on a hacker's list.
2️⃣ Metagoofil – Extract the "hidden" signatures in your files.
3️⃣ Spiderfoot – The ultimate 5-minute digital vibe check.
4️⃣ IntelX – A time machine for data leaks.
5️⃣ WiGLE – How your Wi-Fi name gives away your address.

​Knowledge is your best defense. Use these to audit yourself before someone else does
